chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When death and the extraction of the soul become difficult for the dying person, he should be brought near to the place of salat (prayer) in which he used to pray.

key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the dying person or deceased, here referring to the one upon whom death has become difficult
key_terms.مَوْتُهُ: his death; the onset and occurrence of death
key_terms.نَزْعُهُ: the extraction of his soul; the agonies of dying

ai.seo_question: What should be done when the dying process becomes difficult for a dying person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction concerning a person in the throes of death when the dying process becomes difficult. It directs that the person be brought near the place where he used to perform salat (prayer), indicating a practical ruling connected to the state of dying and the spiritual significance of one's place of worship.
